---
title: "Prepare the spatial neighbor analysis environment"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
---

Install and load the packages used for spatial neighbor analysis. The source script also records example commands for downloading and extracting a Xenium dataset.

Source script: [R/FindNeighbors.R](../R/FindNeighbors.R). The code below retains the source script's order and comments.

## Setup

Enable evaluation and code display for all chunks, and resolve the source script's relative paths from the project root when knitting this file from the Vignettes folder.

```{r setup, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(
  root.dir = normalizePath("..", winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
)
```

## Install packages

Check the required packages and install any that are missing.

```{r step-01, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# reference tutorial: https://sysbiolab.github.io/RGraphSpace/articles/nested-geometries.html

# Install packages
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)){install.packages("BiocManager")}
if (!require("SpatialFeatureExperiment", quietly = TRUE)){BiocManager::install("SpatialFeatureExperiment")}
if (!require("RGraphSpace", quietly = TRUE)){
  if (!require("remotes", quietly = TRUE)){install.packages("remotes")}
  remotes::install_github("sysbiolab/RGraphSpace", build_vignettes=TRUE)}
if (!require("sf", quietly = TRUE)){install.packages("sf")}
if (!require("terra", quietly = TRUE)){install.packages("terra")}

```

## Check the RGraphSpace version

Check the minimum version specified in the source script and update when needed.

```{r step-02, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# Check versions
if (packageVersion("RGraphSpace") < "1.5.4"){
  message("Need to update 'RGraphSpace' for this vignette")
  remotes::install_github("sysbiolab/RGraphSpace")}

```

## Load packages

Attach the libraries used for graph and spatial data workflows.

```{r step-03, eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
# Load packages
library("RGraphSpace")
library("SpatialFeatureExperiment")
library("sf")
library("terra")
library("patchwork")
```
